rv.q: Hyprov is a safe bet for an amusing and inoffensive night at the theater.
For anyone who appreciates improv and is curious about hypnotism (there can’t be many who do it the other way around), Hyprov will prove a fascinating and funny discovery.
HYPROV is good theater and we had fun.

cn.t: Critics find this hybrid of hypnosis and improv entertaining if you accept the premise, though some question the authenticity. Mochrie's improvisational skills shine, but the concept's novelty may outweigh its theatrical substance.
